notes.eta_hat: trajectory-derived OPTIMISTIC UPPER BOUND on the maximal admissible step cap. Only eta_practical > eta_hat is informative; the converse implies nothing.
notes.mu_J: literal Loewner constant via Schur complement; mu_restricted/mu_literal is the factor by which the restricted reading would have understated kappa_J.
notes.path_statistics: min/max over the realized trajectory. These bound A2's region constants (min_t alpha_t >= alpha_*, min_t rho_t >= c_*, max_t rho_t <= C_*); they are not estimates of them.
